chunks: From him, from Ṣafwān, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام about a pregnant woman who sees blood for three days or four days: should she perform salat (prayer)? He said: She should refrain from salat (prayer).
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a pregnant woman who sees blood for three or four days regarding salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a pregnant woman who sees blood for three or four days. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام states that she is to refrain from salat (prayer), indicating the legal effect of such bleeding on her worship.
